lessons.correction: Continue strengthening your ground army, adding more Immortals and supporting units. Keep expanding and increasing your economy.
lessons.mistake: Continuing to strengthen ground and expand without ensuring detection or anti-air, risking a surprise transition to air units like Oracles or Void Rays.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the opponent shows signs of transitioning to air or if you face a timing attack.
lessons.title: Avoid neglecting detection or anti-air when both sides are heavy ground
lessons.when: Midgame, both sides have heavy ground armies and heavy tech. Own army includes Stalkers and Immortals, opponent shows Zealot cues.
lessons.why: Immortals are strong against Zealot-heavy ground compositions common in PvP. Maintaining a heavy economy allows you to outproduce the opponent.

lessons.correction: Focus on developing your economy and technology while maintaining a flexible army composition. Continue expanding and increasing production.
lessons.mistake: Making a large army investment too early, which may delay your tech and economy.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate when you have more scouting information or when you hit a tech milestone.
lessons.title: Avoid over-investing in army early when opponent is unknown
lessons.when: Early game, both sides have heavy economy and technology, but no clear army composition yet. No reliable combat-unit cues from the opponent.
lessons.why: In the early game, investing in tech and economy sets up a strong midgame. Keeping options open allows you to react to the opponent's first moves.

lessons.correction: Continue strengthening your ground army, adding more Immortals and ensuring you have detection. Maintain your economy and expansion.
lessons.mistake: Being too passive, allowing the opponent to build up for a timing attack.
lessons.recheck: Re-evaluate if the opponent transitions to air or if you need to add splash damage.
lessons.title: Avoid being too passive when opponent has heavy ground and detection
lessons.when: Late-midgame, both sides have heavy ground armies and heavy tech. Own army includes Stalkers, Observers, and Immortals, opponent shows Stalker, Sentry, WarpPrism, Observer cues.
lessons.why: Observers provide detection against potential cloaked units, while Immortals are strong against armored ground units. A heavy economy allows you to sustain a large army.
